nom: Drunk Elephant Protini Powerpeptide Resurfacing Serum

avis.texte: I've added this to my rotation of serums to use at night with the polypeptide moisturizer. I mix it in as a "smoothie" and it goes on well — absorbs quickly and lightweight serum. It's gentle to use and my skin has been reacting well to it.

avis.titre: Can't buy this all the time but love it
avis.texte: Like the way this feels on my face, resurfacing or something close to that is how it feels.
Bought this from Ulta today, and it is so watery it was hard to even put on my face. I read such good reviews about this I am super disappointed
At this point I've tried every single DE product & this is my favorite. It's tingly, it works, it's not irritating. Repurchased.
I've used it faithfully twice a day for two weeks, with no noticeable improvement yet.

I cannot get enough of the Protini Powerpeptide Serum. I've noticed such a huge difference with the appearance of my skin and the texture. It's helped with my blemishes, dark spots, ance, and smooth out wrinkles. It's a must have!
Nice resurfacing product. Skin definitely looks smoother. I use about 3 times a week.

avis.titre: I use it frequently; almost every day
avis.texte: Another personal favorite; it does what it says. My face is noticeably smoother after applying this serum.
Not sure I see results. Feels good on. Small amount for the huge packaging

I have been using this serum for a few years, and it seems like the older I get, the better it works! It's just amazing. I only use it at night and make sure my skin is well hydrated with B-Hydra and a good moisturizer on top, plus an oil to seal. I have used competitor products, and they don't even come close to the performance of Resurf serum. The only criticism is the steep price tag.
This is a really awesome product! Not a heavy serum at all. I would definitely buy!

I got a midi size of this a while back and didn't think much, but after using it I've realized I actually really, really like it. My skin looks great when I use this. Part of the reason why this serum stands out is because it has both copper peptides and lactic acid, which means the copper peptides are encapsulated and okay to use with other acidic products. If you are knowledgeable about skincare, you know that copper petides can be really finnicky mixing with other products (Naturium did this in their peptide serum). Unfortunately, this is really expensive, but I've looked for dupes and can't find any.
I received a sample of this product with my purchase of Protini polypeptide cream and love both products!

avis.titre: Wish it did NOT have lactic acid
avis.texte: Love the fact that it has so many peptides. BUT, omg, the lactic acid is super itchy and stinging on my face. I have sensitive skin. Wish Drunk Elephant would make a version of this WITHOUT the lactic acid.

I use exfoliants as supposed to but never seen much improvement in my pores and lines, I guess texture too… that dehydrated look with lines forming. Just large pores. My skin didn't look great even though I took care of it. After using this I'm amazed! I'm in my first week and some break outs but that's normal and using a chemical exfoliant. I'm going to use this every day for my life now. It's made a huge difference in my skin! The difference that I been searching for. Expensive…. But I just signed up in the website so maybe I'll get coupons here or there. But I will for ever use this. Never been a chemical exfoliator person but so glad I gave it a try!

I have very dilated pores, and this serum has spectacular results resurfacing and thightening pores. It dramatically improves overall skin appearance. This is my second bottle, but I will never leave this product.
I am on my 3rd bottle, the packaging is awful. The product gets clumped in gel form around the spring, the pump just doesn't work. Very frustrating for the money spent.

avis.titre: This is an acceptable retinal.Right now
avis.texte: Although some people think this is a little bit too strong, I felt that this was a very good product with did its job. I have since started using prescription retin- a. So I will no longer be using this product.
If you're a 10-year-old just don't buy it if you really want some drunk and get the minis kit it's way better for like seven minutes for the price of one serum

avis.titre: I would try this every time
avis.texte: I love this resurfacing serum. It's the only serum I have that works overnight. My skin is plump and even skin tones. This is also perfect for those who are acne prone. I definitely recommend trying this serum from Drunk Elephant.

I really love this serum it helps so much with skin texture. I usually only use Paula's choice or dermalogica but I wanted to see what the hype was about. I can confirm it is worth it. I noticed a difference within a week

I'm OBSESSED to say the least. I've been using this every morning and night, and I've seen such a difference in my skin texture and even the way my every day makeup applies. I'll definitely be continuing to use this!

unfortunately my skin is very super sensitive and this did not work for me. its a bit too strong and has too many actives. it made my skin freak out a bit. but always patch test! this would be great for other though i bet!

I'm a fan of Drunk Elephant's products, and this serum is no exception. It contains a significant amount of lactic acid, so it's important to gradually build up your tolerance to it. Nevertheless, the active ingredients work wonders on my skin, promoting healthy growth and improving its overall condition over time.

This serum has been a miracle worker for my skin! I've been really struggling with texture and fine lines lately, especially smile lines. I have noticed such a difference since using this serum! My skin looks and feels smoother. The texture of this serum is unlike any other serum I've used. It feels like an oil, but almost like a dry oil. I'm not normally a fan of oily products, but this one doesn't bother me at all!

I have texture on my skin that I would love to get rid of or at least see some change so I have really high hopes for this. It's super hydrating, I like to use it at night and let it sink in. My skin feels a bit smoother but will continue to use for better results. gifted by drunk elephant.

This is my first time to use their product. The packaging is cute and easy to use. I use it as my night serum before moisturizer. I can feel my skin is being so soft and hydrated, but I didn't see any fine lines improvement yet. I'll keep using it.

Drunken Elephant never fails to impress me. This serum, formulated with peptides as the active ingredient, is incredibly gentle and moisturizing. Not only does it visibly shrink my large pores, but it also enhances my skin texture effectively.

This serum is so good! I use it every single day and I do not remember my skin being so glowy. And it exfoliates my skin, so no more dryness! The formula is not too thick and it quickly absorbs into the skin. I can finally say goodbye to dull skin.

The AM/PM exfoliating serum is a powerhouse, transforming my skin's texture, tone, and overall radiance. With 10% lactic acid, it gently exfoliates without irritation, revealing a smoother, more even complexion. The 11 signal peptides are a hydration hero, plumping and firming my skin like never before. It's refreshing to find a vegan product that delivers such visible results. Fine lines and sun damage have diminished noticeably, and my skin has never looked so vibrant and bouncy. An essential addition to any skincare routine.

I've been incorporating lactic acid into my routine slowly and this has been a huge help for my dry skin. This has helped the texture of my skin and help brighten my dull skin. It didn't irritate when I applied so that's a plus.

Drunk Elephant never disappoints! I have aging dry skin, which means I get flaking around my nose and mouth constantly. I'm no stranger to using exfoliators but this still blew me away. The difference after only a couple of days is very noticeable. My skin looks so much more smooth and plump. If you're in the market for a lactic acid serum, give this a shot!

Drunk Elephant's Protini™ Powerpeptide Resurfacing Serum is a skincare powerhouse that has earned a permanent spot in my beauty regimen! 🐘✨ This potent serum combines a blend of peptides and lactic acid to resurface the skin, promoting a smoother, more radiant complexion. From the first few applications, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's texture and tone. It gently exfoliates, reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, without any harsh irritation. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly, making it a perfect addition to both morning and evening routines. For those seeking a boost in skin's firmness and overall glow, this serum is a game-changer. A true testament to the innovative, clean beauty Drunk Elephant is known for!

avis.titre: Love it! Non-irritating formula for me!
avis.texte: Drunk Elephant has the best skin care line in the market in my opinion! This resurfacing serum feels great on the skin. It does not irritate like some other resurfacing serum does to my skin. I can feel my skin getting brighter with use.

This was my second time trying Drunk Elephant, and I'm just as impressed as the first time. This resurfacing serum added so much softness back into my skin. I wear it first thing after I cleanse at night and then after it soaks in I go in with my other steps. I've noticed my skin looks brighter and more even. So after trying this I'm a fan!

I just started using this serum and I'm already seeing incredible results. After just a few uses, my skin feels noticeably plumper, firmer, and more radiant. The appearance of fine lines and pores has diminished and my complexion looks more even and glowing. This mega-strength serum is a game-changer, tackling fine lines, dullness and uneven texture with its potent blend of 10% lactic acid and 11 signal peptides. The lightweight, watery formulation makes it perfect for both AM and PM use and I really like the subtle natural scent of this serum. If you're looking for an advanced, supercharged treatment to elevate your skincare game, this serum is definitely worth trying!

drunk elephant has been my favorite skin care brand for the longest time, this new Protini Powerpeptide Resurfacing Serum is absolutely amazing on my skin, especially during the winter months, recommend it.

The protini serum is amazing! I have sensitive skin that often gets irritated from products that exfoliate. This, however, is totally fine. Using in in the AM, my makeup goes on smoothly without any issues.

I received Protini™ Powerpeptide Resurfacing Serum by Drunk elephant in exchange for my honest review. This serum is game changer, exceed my expectations, it is super lightweight very breathable i just love it the way goes on skin very smooth and absorbed in skin and feel so good. just one drop of serum goes very well on my face its perfect for day and night skin care routine.

I like how the Drunk Elephant Protini™ Powerpeptide Resurfacing Serum is vegan and cruelty-free. Since I have sensitive skin, I appreciate how it is free from essential oils and fragrances. Since using this product at night, I notice my skin looking more radiant and smoother too. There was an improvement in skin texture.

I received this serum as a free gift in exchange for my honest review of the product. The packaging dispenses the perfect amount from the easy-to-use twist top. There is, however, no way to see how much is left in the bottle. I love that this serum gently exfoliates my sensitive skin without any irritation! It is fragrance free and has a very lightweight texture. It absorbs quickly and does not leave my skin feeling sticky. My skin feels soft, smooth, and hydrated.

As someone who has dealt with skin texture since a young age, I am always looking for products that will help minimize as much of the texture on my skin as possible. The Drunk Elephant Protini Powerpeptide Resurfacing Serum did wonders for my skin. It minimizes the texture on my skin that helps me achieve a brighter & even skin tone. I mainly use it at night & follow up with a moisturizer so I can wake up with beautiful skin the next day. Overall, I enjoyed this serum a lot & my skin loved it!

Gifted by Drunk Elephant - This was my first Drunk Elephant skincare product and I was a little disappointed to discover that this serum has an oily consistency. My skin didn't quite absorbed but did looked smooth. The instructions suggests AM and PM but I didn't like to layer a cream on right after a serum who is on the heavier side. At least I didn't get any reactions like redness or burning sensation.

Drunk Elephant's Protini Powerpeptide Resurf Serum significantly enhances the look of skin's texture, tone, brightness, and bounce by combining 10% lactic acid exfoliation with amino acids and skin-fortifying signal peptides. I adore how well their things function.

Another hit from drunk elephant! This serum pans a punch but still feels moisturizing. I started using it once a week a now use 2-3x/week. My skin feels smoother and has more of an awake glow to it. Packaging is sturdy, which there was less plastic!!

This Drunk Elephant Protini Powerpeptide Resurfacing serum is POWERFUL. At first, it goes on a bit oily, but it doesn't take long before it absorbs into the skin and leaves it plumper, diminishing fine lines. It also brightens and evens skin tone in a single use. I love how you can see the results so quickly. This stuff is a game changer.

After using for about a week I notice that my skins texture has improved. I noticed that my pores seem to get a bit smaller as well as leaving a glow to my skin. I would make sure to use moisturizer afterwards if you have dry skin.

This serum is amazing ! It improves my uneven skin tone and my fine lines, I apply it morning and night and it's the best thing… my skin now is more hydrated, brighter and healthier, when I use it before going to bed I wake up with baby skin…

Wow, this left my skin looking so smooth and soft! I have rough texture around my forehead and inner cheek area and have been noticing this has minimized my texture IMMENSELY, and I have small fine lines around my mouth and forehead and now they're hardly noticeable! I also want to add that I have sensitive dry acne prone skin and has improved my acne, as well as not caused any reaction for those with sensitive skin! This Protini is worth every penny with how well it's treating my skin.

I wanted to love this product because drunk elephant is a cult favorite for a reason, but it didn't work on my sensitive skin and irritated it. I'll probably give it to a friend that has chiller skin than my own 😂

After using this product for a couple of weeks, been loving it so far! It's easy to use and apply! It's easy to be absorbed and not sticky at all! It helps smooth the fine lines and makes skin look smooth and moisturizing!

After using this product for the last two weeks, it's been a great experience so far! It's easy to apply and it helps moisturize my skin and make it so smooth and plumped! It absorbed quickly and a little goes a long way!

I really like this serum, it works very well and really improved my overall skin look. It gently exfoliates my skin and makes it soft and smooth without irritating, also it is very hydrating, my skin looks much healthier and radiant now.

This is one of my favorite DE products, and I pair it with their Protini cream every night. The serum's lightweight consistency absorbs seamlessly, contributing to noticeable improvements in my skin's texture and radiance over time. Initially struggling with small bumps, I've seen them vanish, leaving my skin feeling plump and supple. The standout feature for me is the serum's signal peptide complex, with 11 peptides that deeply moisturize and firm the skin, restoring its youthful bounce and glow. As someone who values ethical skincare, I appreciate that this product is vegan and cruelty-free. Moreover, its optimal pH of 3.5 supports skin health without causing any imbalance. After several months of use, the transformation in my skin's condition has been remarkable, making this serum a staple in my nighttime routine.

This exfoliating serum, enriched with 10% lactic acid and 11 signal peptides, significantly improved my skin's texture, tone, and radiance. The vegan formula is gentle yet potent, offering hydration and firmness without irritation. It seamlessly fits into both AM and PM routines, leaving skin feeling plump and rejuvenated.

I recently tried this resurfacing serum and I absolutely love it!! Super lightweight, easy to fit into my skin routine, and I have already started feeling a difference in my skin texture in the short time i've been using it! I normally put it on before bed! No smell, and feels amazing on my skin! 100/10 from me!

This potent serum visibly brightens and evens my skin tone, leaving me with a radiant glow. Packed with peptides and antioxidants, it plumps up fine lines and wrinkles, making my skin look smoother and younger. Despite its resurfacing claims, it's surprisingly gentle and didn't irritate my sensitive skin. It sinks in quickly without leaving any greasy residue, providing a perfect base for makeup. I love knowing that it's formulated with clean, biocompatible ingredients I can trust.

avis.titre: Didn't expect to love it as much as I do!
avis.texte: This protini powerpeptide serum is really liquid-y in form of texture and I use 2 pumps for my entire face and neck. Right away my skin feels softer like what conditioner does to hair. I've been using it for about a week and can already tell my skins texture feels smoother more than any visible difference than I can see.

I've been incorporating this serum into my nightly skincare routine to address the texture issues on my forehead, given my oily and acne-prone skin. Although it initially stings a bit, the sensation fades, and I've noticed a positive impact on my skin's texture. Despite an unusual scent, its effectiveness in problematic areas outweighs that concern. The serum's thin and lightweight consistency isn't sticky like others I've tried. Over the past few days, my skin appears brighter and more even-toned without the dryness associated with previous lactic acid serums. I follow up with my long-time favorite, the Protini moisturizer, and my skin looks plump and healthy.

The Protini serum has really helped improve my skin, making it brighter and clearer. I like its light consistency and pump bottle. So far I've seen positive changes in texture, especially on my forehead. It works well for my sensitive skin. Complimentary from Drunk Elephant.

avis.titre: I will be repurchasing this and I love it!
avis.texte: I use this product in my morning routine and it goes into my skin so well.

This serum is so good for my skin, I love that it makes it helps smooth my skin texture from post acne marks. It's also gentle and my skin feels smooth and glowy. I also like that it doesn't my skin sensitive.

avis.titre: It is good but you can get something similar cheaper
avis.texte: After a few days the top of the bottle was broken, it is too expensive i expected something better than this

I git thus as a free gift with purchase was excited to try it immediately after applying my face started to sting and turn red. I dont have sensitive skin. Its been about 10 minutes and the stinging is wearing off.
I recieved this as a gift and I am in love with it. I use this profuct everyday in my routine! The only bad part was the top broke, but other than that 100% recommend!

I had used the Protini cream and was excited to try this. What a waste of my money. The product itself is just meh. I haven't noticed any difference when using it. On top of that, shortly after purchasing it, the twisting mechanism of the lid started to have difficulty closing. Then one day just broke clean off. It looks like this is a well-known issue with this product, and I'm disgusted that something this ridiculously overpriced can't even manage decent packaging. Now I have a bunch of residual product that I can't even use.

After using this for a while, i would say it's a solid product! only complaint it smells a bit odd, but it's not really a big deal. Leaves a nice shine on the face without looking greasy. Also has lasted me awhile so far. I highly recommend

avis.titre: Leaves skin looking good and soft
avis.texte: This drunk elephant product is amazing! The texture is so smooth and is amazing once applied on skin. It creates softness and shine to my face making a dewy/healthy looking face! There is no scent, but the fact that it already works great on my skin matters more. The packaging is so adorable and I love that you get easy access just to pump out the product. My favorite ingredient is the fruit extract because it gives it that natural ingredient that is needed. I recommend getting drunk elephant because of its amazing packaging and work on the skin

I recently received this Drunk Elephant face serum to try out and it exceeded all my expectations. The texture of the serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin, leaving no greasy or sticky residue behind. It feels incredibly refreshing and hydrating. I love how it provides an instant boost of radiance and leaves my skin feeling smooth and appear more even. It didn't cause any irritation or breakouts to my sensitive skin, which is a huge plus for me. Overall, I cannot recommend this enough. If you're looking for something great to add to your skincare routine this is definitely worth a try.
I've been using DE since it came out because it doesn't use irritants. This has sodium hydroxide. I really wanted to try lactic acid instead of retinol.
Light weight and applies smoothly. Mixes well with other products

I've been using this twice a day for 2 month and I've noticed a difference in the texture and radiance of my skin. It is very liquidy and must be applied carefully. It makes my skin feel tight and renewed. I definitely recommend it, if you like to try different products.
I have not used it as much as I would have liked as I was not a fan of the smell.
Protini serum feels a little oily and skin doesn't feel as good as with the cream. Maybe because it's winter, don't know but protini cream feels great year round
my surface wrinkles improved immediately after using this product one day.
My bottle broke after couple of times of use. Complete waist of my money. Never will purchase again this brand with cheap container that couldn't last at all.

avis.titre: Love the product but has Sodium Hydroxide!!!
avis.texte: The fifth ingredient is Sodium Hydroxide. A skin irritant, that must be why my face burns and tingles when I use it. It makes my skin feel tight and renewed but not at this toxic cost.

avis.titre: Product is good but what is ruining the bottle?
avis.texte: Ultra had no problem replacing the last bottle that started spraying everywhere during the twist to open. But, the new bottle is doing it now too and doesn't close completely. What is in it that is breaking the pump in just this DE product? My guess, they aren't going to replace another one.
I love this but the lid popped off and it is impossible to put back on or get out what's still in the bottle (like 3/4 full)

I have used this several times but have not noticed a big difference. I alternate between this one and retinol every few nights. It is very liquidy and must be applied carefully. It has good reviews so I will keep trying. No breakouts or negative reactions as of yet.

I've been using this twice a day for 3 months and I've noticed a slight difference in the texture and radiance of my skin. However, the improvement is very minimal. Therefore I'd recommend this for those with sensitive skin that want to help unclog pores and promote healthier glowing skin. But, for those with less sensitive or oily skin, this serum will work however you may have to purchase more than once in order to see results. Overall depending on your skin type, I would suggest giving this serum a try. I do love the brand Drunk Elephant although this serum is one of my least favorites from the line.
Great! I just wish that it came in more bundles like the Wild Night or the Trunk. I also love the packaging, but it isn't very resourceful.
This product is really good Help my skin ￼ and here my acne￼ it makes your skin super soft I've been using it for years now my grandma even uses itMy mom uses it everybody
This product is soo good for your skin I have been using it for a while now and I'm obsessed lol some products due to be very bad for my skin but this is no joke
Works so good! This product gave my skin everything it needed. Afterwords my skin felt smooth and soft.
I got it as a gift and it's pretty good. My skin is definitely feeling better.

avis.texte: I love this product but I HATE the packaging!!!! I've wasted so much of this product because it ooozes out even when it's twisted down! I really wish they would reconsider the top/where product dispenses! But other than that the product is great, I love that it doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky or tacky!

very beautiful thing, I have been using it for a long time and have ordered more than once, it is very beautiful❤️ very nice scent and texture this texture is very nice and the smell is lovely
i didn't expect to like it but I find my nearly 67 year old skin looking brighter and smoother than with anything else I've used in the last few years. And also pores are diminished.
Great product, but it sometimes separates despite my shaking it before dispensing, so I don't know if I'm getting a consistent amount of the activating ingredients each use.

Been using for just a few days can tell a difference but it does have a slight oily texture not sure if that could be pore clogging in the future but has been fine for now. Has not much of a scent so good for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Love this product I use it every day
avis.texte: I love this product when I put it on I can feel my skin tightening up.

I've tested this product for so long time and there's only one word in my mind: essential! This serum it's a game changer. It's helped reduce the look of fine lines. It make a big difference out my skin tone and texture!!! Smells ok. 100% free of essential oils, silicones, and fragrance. Vegan and cruelty-free

I absolutely love using this drunk elephant protini serum! I love the packaging and the texture is amazing the ingredients are so amazing and good for the skin! The scent is also very nice! Really recommend😄

avis.titre: Perfect serum for the Protini Polypeptide Cream
avis.texte: This is the 2nd product I have purchased from Drunk Elephant in store after I got the Protini Polypeptide cream and my experience agrees that it has considerably improved my skin texture and glow. I use it daily and so far loving the benefits I am getting from it. ^-^
has a a strong chemical smell, feels tacky on the skin. I have tried other lactic acids I like better.

I got a mini size of this with Sephora points and I really like it! I use it once a week when my skin is feeling dull, dry, and needs to be exfoliated. I put it on directly after cleansing at night and wake up with fresh, smooth skin. It tingles a little bit but doesn't irritate my skin. You can put moisturizer on the top too if it dries out your skin. I don't think I'd buy the full size because of the price, but it's a great product!
This product is really good for your face especially if you have sensitive skin or have acne it is smooth on your face and I definitely do recommend

avis.titre: Some of my acne gone away
avis.texte: This product is good but I thought it would work more fast it took like a month to start getting rid of my acne, but it hydrated my skin really well. It's alright.
This product is great! When it use it consistently (along with the moisturizer) it doesn't make me break out and my skin feels so good!

I'm in my late 30s and deal with dark spots from the sun and uneven skin. This really seemed to help even me out and gave me a lovely glow. This is my favorite drunk elephant products and a regular in my skincare routine.

I love drunk elephants packaging its nice and sleek. And the colours are great. I use the power peptide serum alongside the protini cream. It works like a charm. I alternate nights with the serum. My skin is nice smooth and hydrated.

avis.titre: Terrible waste of product and money
avis.texte: I really like this serum. It's actually the only serum that I've tried and liked enough to buy the full size bottle. BUT the bottle design is AWFUL! Why is it not changed yet Drunk Elephant??? I read the reviews and took a chance but today as I twisted it up the cap popped off, and sure enough inside the bottle is a lot of product wasted down inside the case. It looks like it's been leaking down the side every time I've pumped it, and this stuff isn't cheap. The cap won't go back on without wasting more product. I DO NOT RECOMMEND BUYING THIS UNTIL DRUNK ELEPHANT CHANGES THE BOTTLE!!!! NOR WILL I PURCHASE ANYMORE PRODUCTS UNTIL THE COMPANY ACKNOWLEDGES IT HAS A DEDIGN FLAW AND MAKES IT RIGHT WITH THEIR CUSTOMERS!!!!

I ended up returning this because it was way too oily for every day wear. I am a huge DE fan but this was a miss. You need to shake for a few minutes to get the product to combine and then it still leaves a dewy heavy oily feel on your face. Can't speak to the effectiveness but the serum left me too oily.
A little goes a long way, and it makes my skin so soft and smooth!

I've been using Protini Powerpeptide since it first came out and can honestly say, although expensive, it's worth every penny! Protini Powerpepride and C-Firma are the two DE products I cannot live without! If I weren't actually seeing results; smaller pores, firmer skin, a dramatic reduction in hyperpigmentation and overall brighter, plumper skin, I would never spend as much as I do on skincare. My routine is exclusively DE. B-Hydra, A-Shaba, Protini powerpeptide, and C-Firma in the day and Framboos, A-Passioni, F-Balm, and Protini at night. I use D-Bronzini and LaLa Retro mixed and O-Bloos on non-makeup days, and T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial every Sunday. My daily cleanser is Beste no 9 and Slaai Makeup-Melting Butter for makeup removal. I have a collection of other products that I alternate with on occasion depending on my skin needs. I always store my DE products in the fridge, a regular fridge because the makeup ones aren't efficient, and it keeps them all fresh. I started this when I first started using C-Firma to keep it the pale yellow color it was when new. Thank goodness for the new C-Firma Fresh you mix yourself. I like to buy my products directly from DE because I feel I'm getting a fresher product, but there are times I take advantage of my Sephora and Ulta memberships for discounts which really helps given the number of products I use. I highly recommend Drunk Elephant to anyone serious about taking care of their skin, it's absolutely true that you get what you pay

I am using for the first time and LOVE the product, but the pump top got wonky and I had to work to get it closed after a while. Now it won't pump at all and won't close at all, so it's open to air and I don't feel safe using it. That was a lot of product down the drain.

I love their serums! I had gotten a bottle of this a while back and consistently used it. I rotate between this and the framboos. The top of this bottle broke and came off and I never could get it to pop back on properly. There was product coming out everywhere and was making such a mess that I couldn't use it because of this. I still had a half a bottle left though and didn't want to toss it. I emailed drunken elephant and without hesitation they asked for the code on the bottom of the defective bottle and immediately had me a new bottle processed and on the way and it will be here tomorrow. I'm impressed with their customer service!! I love this serum and will continue using their products.

I like the product but I don't like not knowing when it is close to being done. I also think the packaging is over the top. In a time when we are trying to minimize waste for the environment, the packaging could be more simple.
I have noticed some changes since I started using it, my skin is slightly clearer and feels more refreshed. If you are willing to spend the money on drunk elephant I would say it's a good option.

avis.titre: Love the product, hate the packaging.
avis.texte: I've used this product for several years, purchasing probably 6 or 7 bottles. The last THREE bottles I have purchased have all bad issues with the pump. The pump breaks shortly into using it, making the product basically unusable.
